## Context
Story: 7cf8-84fc-c5ea-48ff — sprint shared scripts accept caller-specific prefixes and PR title/body

## Goal
Add RED tests for DRAFT_PR_TITLE_PREFIX and DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE env vars to tests/scripts/test-create-sprint-draft-pr.sh and append RED marker to .test-index.

NOTE: .test-index must be written after T3's RED marker write (depends-on T3) to serialize concurrent writes.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| tests/scripts/test-create-sprint-draft-pr.sh | modify | n/a | n/a |
| .test-index | modify | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
1. Open tests/scripts/test-create-sprint-draft-pr.sh
2. Append new test cases:
   - test_create_sprint_draft_pr_custom_title_prefix:
     * Given: DRAFT_PR_TITLE_PREFIX="Debug:" set in env; mode=no_pr
     * When: script runs with SESSION_BRANCH="sprint-abc123" PRIMARY_TICKET_ID="epic-001" EPIC_TITLE="My Epic"
     * Then: gh pr create is called with a title matching "Debug: My Epic"
     * Assert: gh call log contains "Debug: My Epic"
   - test_create_sprint_draft_pr_default_title_prefix:
     * Given: DRAFT_PR_TITLE_PREFIX unset; mode=no_pr
     * When: script runs normally
     * Then: gh pr create is called with default title containing "Sprint:"
     * Assert: gh call log contains "Sprint:"
   - test_create_sprint_draft_pr_custom_body_template:
     * Given: DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE="Debug session for {{PRIMARY_TICKET_ID}}" set in env; mode=no_pr
     * When: script runs with PRIMARY_TICKET_ID="epic-001"
     * Then: gh pr create body contains "Debug session for epic-001" (placeholder interpolated)
     * Assert: gh call log contains "Debug session for epic-001"
   - test_create_sprint_draft_pr_default_body_regression:
     * Given: DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE unset; mode=no_pr
     * When: script runs with PRIMARY_TICKET_ID="epic-001"
     * Then: gh pr create body matches current literal: "Long-lived sprint draft PR. Epic: epic-001."
     * Assert: gh call log contains "Long-lived sprint draft PR. Epic: epic-001."
     * Purpose: regression guard for existing sprint caller behavior
   - test_create_sprint_draft_pr_body_no_placeholder:
     * Given: DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE="Custom body no placeholder" set in env; mode=no_pr
     * When: script runs
     * Then: body is used as-is (no interpolation needed, no crash)
     * Assert: gh call log contains "Custom body no placeholder"
3. Append RED marker to .test-index:
   - Line: plugins/dso/scripts/create-sprint-draft-pr.sh: [test_create_sprint_draft_pr_custom_title_prefix, test_create_sprint_draft_pr_default_title_prefix, test_create_sprint_draft_pr_custom_body_template, test_create_sprint_draft_pr_default_body_regression, test_create_sprint_draft_pr_body_no_placeholder]
4. The existing gh stub logs all gh pr create calls including --body and --title args to _GH_CALL_LOG; use gh_was_called_with() helper for assertions

## Acceptance Criteria
- tests/scripts/test-create-sprint-draft-pr.sh contains tests for DRAFT_PR_TITLE_PREFIX (custom, default) and DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE (custom with placeholder, default regression guard, no-placeholder passthrough)
- .test-index contains RED marker for create-sprint-draft-pr.sh referencing all 5 new test function names
- New tests FAIL (RED phase) — env vars not yet honored in script
- bash tests/run-all.sh exits non-zero but new test failures are expected (RED markers)
- ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
- ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
